scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

X_BEARER_TOKEN.description: **Required.** App-only Bearer Token from an app on your own [X developer account](https://developer.x.com) — the free tier cannot read conversations, so the account needs pay-per-use billing enabled. X bills you about **$0.005 per post read**, so set a spending limit in the developer console before you load anything.

X_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. OAuth 2.0 Client ID from the same X app, with *Type of App* set to **confidential client**. Adds the Your posts tab and bookmark-folder sync. Register `https://<your-worker-url>/auth/callback` as the app's callback first, and give this deployment an X app of its own — X keeps only one live grant per user per client id.

X_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. The matching OAuth 2.0 Client Secret. Use the portal's *Show* button rather than regenerating — regenerating revokes any grant you already have.
